name: task-anchor
description: Preserve the original task instruction across Codex context compactions.

interface.shortDescription: Keep original task instructions across compactions.
interface.longDescription: Stores an explicitly anchored instruction once, then injects it after compaction only while the task remains in the same Git project or non-Git workspace.
defaultPrompt: 使用 $task-anchor 锚定当前任务，并开始执行。
